name: clickhouse
description: Run SQL against ClickHouse over its native HTTP interface — query, export to a delimited file, import from one, and inspect databases and tables. No JDBC driver to install.
assistantDescription: Run SQL against a ClickHouse cluster over its HTTP interface. Operations: execute (run any SQL; a SELECT publishes rows as JSON plus columns/rowCount), export (stream a query result to a delimited file), import (load a delimited file into a table, matching columns by header name), list-databases, list-tables (needs database), describe (needs database + table). Requires a 'clickhouse' credential holding the host in Server, the user in Login, the password in Secret, and optionally a default database and an ssl flag. Use this for analytical/OLAP SQL on ClickHouse rather than runtimeenv or spawn scripts.
